title: How to Explain Gaps In Your Resume
description:
Facing the nerve-wracking question: "Can you clarify this gap in your resume?"

We understand the stress of explaining resume gaps and how to articulate them. The truth is, there's no one-size-fits-all approach to handling these gaps. If you ask 10 recruiters how to explain gaps in your resume, you'll likely get 10 different answers.

To include or not to include? That is the question.

In this video, we'll dive into how to explain a gap in your resume, the various reasons behind them, and how to effectively address them - and whether or not you should. 

Life can be unpredictable, and gaps in employment? They happen.
